source.description: The TGA parser reads attacker-controlled RLE pixel bytes from QDataStream into the local pixel buffer with s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size); this project parser read is the scored source.

sink.description: MSan reports use of an uninitialized palette index when qRgb reads palette entries selected by idx.

root_cause.description: The vulnerable RLE branch ignores a short read into pixel[8], so part of pixel remains uninitialized and is copied into the image buffer.

taint_source.description: Attacker-controlled TGA RLE pixel bytes are read into the local pixel buffer.

tainted_value_origin.description: A palette index is materialized from the image buffer after the RLE pixel copy.

root_cause_analysis.summary: The PoC is parsed as a TGA image. In the RLE pixel branch, LoadTGA reads one encoded pixel into the local pixel[8] buffer but ignores the number of bytes actually returned. If the input ends before pixel_size bytes are read, the remaining bytes in pixel stay uninitialized. The code then memcpy()s the full pixel_size into the image buffer. Later the paletted conversion loads idx from image and uses it to index palette entries, causing MSan to report use-of-uninitialized-value at qRgb/palette access.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch checks dataRead from s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size) and zero-fills pixel[dataRead..pixel_size). Thus memcpy(dst, pixel, pixel_size) always copies initialized bytes. The fixed ARVO image exits without the MSan warning for the same PoC.
